page_title: HuggingGPT: Solving AI Tasks with ChatGPT and its Friends in Hugging Face

summary.name: HuggingGPT
summary.one_liner: HuggingGPT is a research paper presenting an LLM-powered agent that uses ChatGPT to plan tasks and route them to AI models from Hugging Face to solve complex multi-modal AI tasks.
use_cases: Research on LLM-based agents that coordinate multiple AI models
Understanding task planning and model selection with an LLM controller
Exploring multimodal AI tasks across language, vision, and speech
Background reading on steps toward artificial general intelligence
summary.what_it_does: The paper proposes using a large language model as a controller that manages existing AI models. When it receives a user request, ChatGPT plans the tasks, selects models based on their function descriptions on Hugging Face, executes each subtask with the chosen model, and then summarizes the results. The authors say this approach covers tasks across different modalities and domains, including language, vision, and speech. The page is an arXiv abstract listing (cs.CL), with version history from March 2023 to December 2023 and links to the PDF and HTML versions.
notable: Uses ChatGPT as a planner that routes subtasks to Hugging Face models
Selects models using their Hugging Face function descriptions
Language serves as the generic interface between the LLM and the AI models
Published on arXiv as cs.CL, four versions from March to December 2023
caveats: The page is an abstract listing; it does not describe a downloadable tool or usage instructions
The abstract claims impressive results but gives no specific benchmarks on this page
Abstract says existing AI models alone cannot handle complicated tasks autonomously, which is the paper's motivation rather than a tested limitation
